Subarnarekha Valley Corporation 
 
 PSU CLIENT · Jharkhand · IN 
 
 
 REFERENCE LETTER 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern 
 
 Ref: REF/60/91 Date: 31/03/2026 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern, 
 
 This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said agency has
 executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been found satisfactory.
 
 1. PROJECT DETAILS 
 
 Project Name Rail Tunnel - Jharkhand Pkg-102 
 
 Scope of Work Tunnels works for Subarnarekha Valley Corporation completed 2015.
 
 Nature of Work Tunnels 
 
 Contract Value INR 172.22 Cr 
 
 Date of Completion 2015-03-05 
 
 Contractor's Role Prime 
 
 2. PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT 
 
 Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was professional, though correspondence on variations was
 occasionally slow, and . On that basis the agency is recommended for works of comparable scope and value.
 
 Criterion Rating Observation 
 
 Adherence to Schedule Excellent Project delivered within contractual timeline
 
 Quality of Work Excellent Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications
 
 Safety Record Good BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout 
 
 Responsiveness Excellent Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs 
 
 Financial Integrity Good Billing was accurate and supported by records
 
 3. RECOMMENDATION 
 
 We confirm that National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. executed the referenced work to our satisfaction. Their
 performance on schedule, quality, and safety was commendable. 
 
 We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in the
 future. This reference is valid for a period of High from the date of this letter.
